name: Poseidon's Wrath
description: On success: recharge 1 round & Tidal Echo +30% next Water hit

name: Stone Golem
description: Seismic fissure · one enemy

name: Professor Volt
description: 20% stun chance on hit · target skips one action

name: Lady Estel
description: Blesses one ally: up to 750 HP

name: Tornado Barrage
description: 200 damage to each enemy; next cast gets +10 accuracy points on hit

name: Crimson Siphon
description: Vampire steals up to 550 HP, returns and offers a red orb healing 50% of HP actually drained

name: Dragonfire Descent
description: Baby dragon drops in, charges a giant fireball and hits 650 + 150 to each adjacent enemy. 25% burn: 50 for 3 turns

name: Icefang Rampage
description: An icicle-furred polar bear roars, charges and claws one enemy for 460 damage, then disperses

name: Reef Rush
description: A dorsal fin slowly rises and circles before a shark jumps straight up, flops at the apex, then arches downward onto one target and chomps for 480 damage, then splashes back beneath the arena floor

name: Thunderclap
description: A dark thundercloud being with electric-blue eyes forms at the arena center, spreads its arms and claps, firing an arcing bolt at one enemy for 550 damage

name: Flaming Arrows
description: A slanted fire rune circle rains a barrage of flaming arrows across all enemies. Each enemy hit takes 150 total damage with an independent 10% chance to burn for 50 damage at the start of each of the next 3 rounds

name: Wind Slashes
description: A wandering samurai drops into the arena, slowly reaches for his sheathed katana, then draws it in a flash and releases three rapid wind slashes at one enemy. Each slash deals 150 damage: 450 total. 80% spell accuracy

name: Reaper
description: A red-eyed hooded Reaper rises from a shadow circle, lunges and slashes for 950 damage. Applies Decaying Strength: the next successful damaging spell against that enemy deals 20% more damage, including all hits of that spell

name: Stone Bender
description: An earthbender appears with arms crossed, takes a palm-and-fist stance, then lifts her forward foot and stomps hard in front of her to raise a huge rectangular stone wall. She punches it into a barrage of broken stones, dealing 540 total damage to one enemy

name: Frosty
description: A winter gust reveals a happy snowman. He turns angry, becomes a muscular snow giant and hurls a huge snowball for 750 damage. He melts away after the throw, with a 30% chance to inflict Frostbite: 50 damage per turn for 3 turns

name: Solidity
description: An earth-symbol shield travels to yourself or a living ally and dissolves into a Solidity rune. Reduces every hit of the next successful damaging spell by 25%, then expires. Misses and damage over time do not consume it. Does not stack.

name: Calming Waters
description: Calming currents bless yourself or a living ally. Restores 125 HP at the start of each of the next 3 turns: 375 total. Cannot exceed maximum HP or revive a defeated wizard. Reapplying refreshes the duration; it does not stack.

name: Static Shock
description: Curses one enemy with −30 percentage points of spell accuracy for 3 turns (80% becomes 50%). On their first missed spell, discharges for 100 damage and expires. Successful spells leave the curse active until its duration ends. Refreshes without stacking.

name: Blazing Rage
description: Fiery energy blesses yourself or a living ally. Their next successful damaging Fire spell deals 20% more damage, including every hit and target of that spell. Misses, healing and support spells preserve it. Refreshes without stacking.

name: Turbulence
description: Restless wind curses one enemy. Their next spell loses 50 percentage points of accuracy. An 80% spell becomes 30% accurate (70% failure). Combines with Static Shock and other active accuracy effects. Consumed on the next cast attempt, whether it succeeds or fails. Does not stack.

name: Soul Drain
description: Curses one enemy for 3 turns. At the start of each turn, drains up to 100 HP and restores the HP actually drained to the caster, capped at maximum HP. 300 total drain. Cannot revive a defeated caster. Reapplying refreshes the curse without stacking.

name: Healing Aura
description: Blesses every living teammate, including yourself. Each restores 200 HP at the start of each of the next 3 turns: 600 HP per ally. Capped at maximum HP; cannot revive. Works alongside Calming Waters. Reapplying refreshes this aura without stacking copies.

name: Freezing Temps
description: Marks one enemy. The next successful damaging Ice spell consumes the mark for a 50% chance to freeze them for up to 3 turns. Before each frozen turn, thaw chances rise from 20% to 40% to 60%. Failed thaw rolls skip the turn; automatically unfreezes after the third turn. Misses and other elements preserve the mark.

name: Scorpion Sting
description: A giant orange scorpion rolls down curled into an armored ball, unfolds, pauses, winds up its tail and stings one enemy for 340 damage. 30% chance to poison for 50 HP per turn for 3 turns, then digs and burrows beneath the arena.

name: Octo Whip
description: A large blue octopus slams down, flails angrily and whips one enemy for 400 damage. 15% chance to flinch: skips their action this turn only if they have not acted yet. No carryover to the next turn.

name: Devil Boy
description: A small red demon appears in a burst of flames, aims his musket-style pistol and fires a glowing volcanic rock at one enemy for 250 Fire damage, then disappears in another burst of flames.

name: Blooming Spores
description: A huge spotted closed flower bud bulges with pressure, then bursts open into full bloom and releases spore dust, dealing 100 Nature damage to every enemy. Each enemy hit has an independent 30% chance to be poisoned for 50 HP per turn for 3 turns.

name: Lightning Rod
description: Self-only Lightning rune for the next 5 turns. Each later Lightning cast by you or any ally, even a miss, stores 1 charge. At the end of the fifth turn, discharges 100 damage per charge TOTAL, split among living enemies. Lightning Rod itself never charges it. Recasting refreshes duration without stacking runes or losing stored charges.

name: Undead Rampage
description: A gaunt hooded zombie rips one arm through the ground, then the other, hauls itself free, screeches and pounces onto one enemy for a 200-damage Dark claw strike. On a successful hit, 10% chance to Fear: skips the target only if they have not acted yet this round. No effect if they already acted; never carries into the next round.

name: Forrest Centaur
description: A centaur in woodland leaves, vines and bark garments gallops into position, plants his hooves, draws and charges his bow, then snipes one enemy with a Nature arrow for 650 damage.

name: Wind Dome
description: Rapidly rotating wind forms a protective dome around yourself. Blocks every hit and on-hit effect of the next incoming damaging spell, then disappears. Misses, support spells and all damage from debuffs preserve it. Lasts until used; reapplying refreshes one shield without stacking.

name: Ninja Penguins
description: Three ninja penguins flip into the arena with ice kunai. Two launch their teammate diagonally above one enemy; he spins and throws 3 fast kunai for 100 damage each. Each hit has a 10% chance of Frostbite: 50 damage per turn for 3 turns. Frostbite cannot stack or refresh from later kunai.

name: Blizzard
description: Whipping icy winds rip through every enemy for 160 damage. Each enemy hit has a 60% chance of Extreme Frostbite: 100 damage per turn for 5 turns. Refreshes one Frostbite without stacking.

name: Thorny Wrap
description: A thorny vine erupts beneath one enemy and wraps around them for 3 turns. Each spell attempt deals 150 damage to the wrapped caster, even if their spell misses. While attached: −15 accuracy points. Refreshes without stacking.

name: Kinetic Sand
description: Sand whirls at the arena center, rises into a towering wave and dives onto one enemy. It encases the target, then clenches in a crushing grip for 620 Earth damage before crumbling away.

name: Zeus’s Might
description: Zeus descends waist-up in a cloud, winds up and hurls his golden thunderbolt for 1,350 damage. Lightning then chains to each immediate adjacent enemy for 200 damage. Every target hit has an independent 20% chance to lose one action to stun.

name: Gunpowder Kiss
description: A mistress made entirely of gunpowder forms from thin air and blows a powder kiss onto one enemy. Gunpowder Coat lasts 3 turns. A Fire spell hit ignites it for 150 extra damage, once per turn and up to 3 times. The coat stays after each explosion. Reapplying refreshes without stacking. Burn ticks do not trigger it.

name: Flow State
description: Enter Flow State. Gain 1 extra mana at the start of each of your next 3 turns: 2 mana after casting, or 3 after passing, up to your mana capacity. Lasts for 3 mana gains, including skipped turns. Reapplying refreshes without stacking.

name: Wind Fist Barrage
description: A monk drops into a three-point crouched landing, stands, claps his hands and bows, then takes an open-palm forward stance. He leaps up and unleashes ten forceful wind fists at one enemy: 50 damage per punch, 500 total. 85% spell accuracy.

name: Jack the Lantern
description: A pumpkin-headed scarecrow rises with its head bowed as three crows circle overhead. It lifts its head to face one enemy, sending the crows to swarm for 280 Dark damage. Inflicts Fear for 3 rounds: a 30% chance to skip each turn. Refreshes without stacking.

name: Creeping Croc
description: A crocodile floats almost completely submerged toward one enemy, showing only its eyes, the top of its head and its ridged back. It suddenly lunges from the water and snaps for 800 damage. On hit: 10% chance to Fear, skipping the target only if they have not acted yet this round. Never carries into the next round.

name: Electrical Charge
description: Charge yourself immediately through the next 3 rounds. Gain 1 mana each time a Lightning spell reaches you, once per cast, up to your mana capacity. Includes chain lightning and Lightning Rod discharge. Misses do not charge you. Uses your debuff slot and cannot refresh or stack.

name: Grill Master
description: A living cast-iron grill heats up under a closed lid, then snaps its jaws open and blasts one enemy for 440 base Fire damage. A successful hit has a 20% chance to Burn for 50 damage per round for 3 rounds.

name: Venus Trap
description: A giant Venus flytrap sprouts at the center of the arena, rears up and roars, then stretches out to engulf one enemy for 400 base Nature damage.

name: Heizmann
description: Slash one enemy for 600 base Ice damage. A 20% Freeze chance seals them in ice. If they remain unfrozen, the shell shatters for another 350 base Ice damage.

name: Boulder Weight
description: Heavy stone pauldrons and sleeves weigh down one enemy. Their spell accuracy drops by 30 percentage points for 3 turns.

name: Cyclops
description: A one-eyed giant roars and flings his heavy club in a flat spin at one enemy for 760 base Earth damage.

name: Acid Air
description: A toxic wind coils around one enemy’s face and inflicts Extreme Poison for 100 base damage at the start of each of the next 5 turns.

name: Decay of Strength
description: Mark one enemy. The next damaging spell against them deals 20% more damage across its hits. If status damage lands first, that damage event gains 20% and spends the mark.

name: Burning Pheonix
description: A blazing ground flame rises into a phoenix. It beats its wings high above the arena and dives into one enemy for 1,100 base Fire damage.

name: Electro Disc
description: Three electro discs deal 120 damage each to one enemy.

name: Zen
description: Choose one negative rune on yourself or an ally to remove.

name: Scalding Air
description: 140 damage. 40% chance of Extreme Burn: 100 damage per round for 5 rounds.

name: TREE!
description: 720 damage. 30% chance to plant a Healing Seed that transfers up to 75 HP to the caster each round for 5 rounds.

name: Bullet Seed
description: Five seeds deal 30 damage each. 40% chance per cast to apply Healing Seed for 5 rounds.

name: Yeti
description: A yeti breathes frost, charges one enemy, and smashes with both fists.

name: Totally Rad
description: Launches a giant snowball for 320 damage. 15% chance of Frostbite: 50 damage per round for 3 rounds.

name: Lightning Ball
description: 350 initial damage. Bounces to a new enemy at 70%, 60%, 50%, then 10 points less per bounce. Each bounce deals 10% less base damage.

name: Wicked Witch
description: 520 Dark damage. Fire, Ice, Poison, and Lightning beams each have a 25% chance. Each has a 30% chance of its matching status: Burn, Frostbite, Poison, or skip this round.

name: Kamikaze?
description: A gremlin plants a bomb, then picks it back up after the fuse goes dark. The explosion hits one enemy for 470 Fire damage.

name: Raging Waters
description: Place a rune on yourself. Your next damaging Water spell that lands deals 25% more damage on every hit. Does not stack.

name: Crab Giant
description: A giant crab flexes both pincers, then lunges and clamps one claw shut for 670 Water damage to one enemy.

name: Meteor Shower
description: A staggered meteor barrage deals 420 Earth damage to each enemy. Each meteor has a 25% chance to apply Decay of Strength (+20% damage taken from the next damaging spell or status tick).

name: Mana Scourge
description: Mark one enemy until the rune blocks a round-end mana gain. Full mana preserves the rune.

name: Soul Harvest
description: Hook one enemy for 540 base damage and trap their soul in a lantern. Soulless deals 250 damage after 3 rounds.

name: Sirens Melody
description: A siren rises on a rock and sings. Restores up to 350 base HP to each living ally, including you.

name: Quick Sand
description: Lasts 5 rounds. The target sinks on each cast attempt, even on a miss. On the third attempt, they take 530 damage and the curse ends.

name: Reikel
description: Pierces one enemy for 670 base Fire damage. On hit, 30% chance to destroy one random beneficial rune. Wind Dome blocks both effects.

name: Crystal Ice Mirrors
description: Mark one enemy for 3 rounds. Each damaging cast has a 40% chance to turn its damage back on the caster instead. Multi-hit spells roll once. Team attacks reflect one target’s share.
